title: Booking a table for a family lunch

lines.t: Good morning, Garden Cafe. How can I help you?
Hello. I would like to book a table for Sunday lunch, please.
Of course. How many people will there be?
Six people. We are four adults and two children.
And what time would you like to come?
At half past twelve, if possible.
Yes, that is fine. We have a nice table by the window. Can I have your name, please?
Yes, it is Karim Benali. Karim is K, A, R, I, M. Benali is B, E, N, A, L, I.
Thank you, Mr Benali. Do you need anything special?
Yes, one high chair, please. My niece is only one year old.
No problem. I will write that down. We will see you on Sunday.
Thank you very much. Goodbye.

qs.q: Which day does the family want to come?
How many people will come? ___
What time is the booking?
Where is the table?
The family name is ___.
qs.why: تهجئة الاسم: B, E, N, A, L, I.

qs.q: The family needs a high chair for a baby.
qs.why: طلب كرسياً مرتفعاً لابنة أخته الصغيرة.

title: Asking for directions to the station

lines.t: Excuse me. Can you help me, please? I am looking for the train station.
Sure. It is not far from here. Do you see the big bank on the corner?
Yes, I do.
Go past the bank and turn left at the traffic lights.
Turn left at the lights. Okay.
Then walk along Park Street for about five minutes. You will see a small library on your right.
A library on my right. Good.
The station is just after the library, opposite the bus stop.
Is it better to walk or to take a bus?
Walk. The bus is slow at this time, and it costs two dollars.
Thank you so much for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice day!

qs.q: What is on the corner near the speaker?
qs.why: قال: the big bank on the corner.

qs.q: Where must the man turn left?
qs.why: قال: turn left at the traffic lights.

qs.q: He walks along Park Street for about ___ minutes.
Where is the library?
The station is opposite the bus stop.
The bus costs ___ dollars.

title: A voicemail from a friend about the weekend

lines.t: Hi Sara, it's Tom. Sorry, I missed your call. I'm calling about the weekend.
On Saturday morning, I'm going to play football with my brother. The match starts at ten o'clock, so I will be free after lunch.
Do you want to go to the new market in the afternoon? It opens at two. I want to buy a birthday present for my mother.
After that, we can have a coffee. My cousin Lina works in a small cafe near the market, and she can give us a cake for free.
On Sunday, I have to help my father in the garden, but I'm free in the evening. Maybe we can watch a film at my house.
Please call me back before Friday night. My number is the same as always. Bye for now!

qs.q: What will Tom do on Saturday morning?
The football match starts at ___ o'clock.
Tom wants to buy a birthday present for his ___.
What time does the market open?
Tom's cousin works in a cafe.
qs.why: قال: my cousin Lina works in a small cafe.

qs.q: When is Tom free on Sunday?
qs.why: يساعد والده ثم يكون متفرغاً مساءً.

lines.t: Good afternoon. Can I help you?
Yes, please. I have a bad headache and a sore throat.
How long have you had them?
Since yesterday morning. I also feel a little tired.
Do you have a fever?
No, I don't think so.
Okay. I can give you some tablets for the headache. Take one tablet after breakfast and one after dinner.
How many days should I take them?
For three days. And these sweets are good for your throat. Drink lots of warm water, too.
How much is everything?
The tablets are six pounds and the sweets are three pounds. That is nine pounds in total.
Here you are. Thank you.
If you still feel ill on Friday, please see a doctor.

qs.q: What problems does the customer have?
o: A headache and a sore throat

qs.q: Since when does he feel ill?
The customer has a fever.
qs.why: قال: No, I don't think so.

qs.q: He must take the tablets for ___ days.
The total price is ___ pounds.
qs.why: ستة زائد ثلاثة تساوي تسعة جنيهات.

qs.q: When should he see a doctor?

lines.t: Hello. How can I help you?
Hi. I need a ticket to Boston, please.
One way or return?
Return, please. I want to come back on the same day.
Okay. The next train leaves at eleven forty from platform four.
Platform four. Is it a fast train?
Yes, it takes two hours. There is also a slower train at noon, but it takes three hours.
I will take the fast one, please. How much is it?
A return ticket is thirty-eight dollars. Are you a student?
Yes, I am. Here is my student card.
Great. With the card, you pay thirty dollars.
Wonderful. Can I pay by card?
Of course. Please put it in the machine.

qs.q: The man wants a ticket to ___.
What kind of ticket does he buy?
What time does the fast train leave?
The train leaves from platform ___.
How long is the fast train journey?
With the student card the ticket costs ___ dollars.

lines.t: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Old Castle. My name is Mia, and I will be your guide today.
The tour takes about ninety minutes. First, we will walk around the garden. Then we will go inside to see the great hall and the kitchen.
Please stay with the group, and do not touch the old furniture. You can take photos, but please do not use a flash.
At half past eleven, we will have a short break. There is a small shop near the exit, and you can buy water and postcards there.
The castle is about seven hundred years old. A king built it to protect the town, and later a family lived here for three hundred years.
Does anyone have a question? No? Then please follow me.

qs.q: The guide's name is ___.
How long is the tour?
What will the group see first?
Visitors can use a flash for photos.
qs.why: قالت: please do not use a flash.

qs.q: The break is at half past ___.
How old is the castle?

lines.t: Hello. Welcome to City Sports Club. Are you a new member?
Not yet. I would like to join, please. I want to learn swimming.
Great. We have swimming lessons on Monday and Wednesday evenings, from six to seven.
Is that for beginners?
Yes, it is. The teacher is very friendly. His name is Mr Green.
How much does it cost?
Membership is twenty pounds a month. If you pay for a year, you get two months free.
That is a good price. Do I need to bring anything?
Yes. Bring a towel, a swimming cap and a bottle of water. We have lockers, but you need a one pound coin.
Okay. Can I try one lesson first?
Of course. Come this Monday, and the first lesson is free.

qs.q: What does the man want to learn?
qs.why: قال: I want to learn swimming.

qs.q: When are the lessons?
The teacher's name is Mr ___.
qs.why: قالت: His name is Mr Green.

qs.q: Membership costs ___ pounds a month.
He must bring a towel and a swimming cap.
qs.why: طلبت منه منشفة وقبعة سباحة وزجاجة ماء.

qs.q: What is free?
